SELECT event_id, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / total_count AS quotient
FROM (
    SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY event_id
) AS event_counts
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
        FROM attendance
        GROUP BY link_to_event
    )
) AS totals
WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quotient DESC
LIMIT 10
